degree_rationale: Men whose body's eye blossoms forth — those who fall into a brief sickness, whose soul is loosed from the body; some come back quickly, others delay. Mystical seeing through the seven men of light. Treats the natural-bodily completion of mystical experience.
direction_rationale: Settled-completion of mystical seeing — the body's eye blossoming as completion-experience near death. West = the rest at the threshold.
grand_man_function: Natural mystical-eye completion — the body's vision at the threshold.
title: Men whose body's eye blossoms forth (mystical seeing)
